_comment: Copied to data/watchlist.json on first start and edited there through the interface. Groups: portfolio (alerts), watchlist, auto (added by Discover). Dates as YYYY-MM-DD.

companies.name: Apple
companies.context: Consumer electronics (iPhone, Mac, iPad, wearables) and services (App Store, iCloud, Apple Music). Not meant: the fruit, Apple Records, Apple Hospitality REIT.

searches.q: Apple (earnings OR guidance OR iPhone OR "App Store" OR analyst OR China OR demand)

companies.name: ASML
companies.context: Dutch maker of lithography systems for chip production (EUV, DUV). Quarterly results include net bookings, which the market watches closely.

searches.q: ASML (earnings OR bookings OR guidance OR EUV OR analyst OR China OR export)

companies.name: SAP
companies.context: German enterprise software (ERP, cloud, Business AI). Key metric: current cloud backlog. Not meant: SAP as an abbreviation in other contexts.

searches.q: SAP (earnings OR "cloud backlog" OR guidance OR analyst OR S/4HANA)
SAP (Zahlen OR Prognose OR Cloud OR Analyst)
